==Description==
The '''Stone Viking''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[The Heights]] as part of the [[SFOTH Event]]. It had the same speed as the [[Normal]], meaning it was faster than the [[Knight (The Heights)|Knight]] and [[Slow]], while also having more health than the [[Knight (The Heights)|Knight]]. It could have also been spawned by the [[Swordmaster]].

==Appearance==
The '''Stone Viking''' had grey skin with the slate texture. It had straps across their body and wore an 8-bit Viking helmet. It was completely faceless and wielded a stone sword. However, the '''Stone Viking''' could not attack towers with its sword.

==Strategy==
*While high DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], are effective, it is also recommended to have splash damage towers, such as the [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]], as the '''Stone Viking''' spawn in hordes.
**The [[Commander]] can also assist in defeating the '''Stone Viking''' as it boosts the firerate of these towers.
*As the '''Stone Viking''' is faster than the [[Knight (The Heights)|Knight]], having a [[Pyromancer]] or [[Freezer]] is recommended to slow it down.

==Trivia==
*Actual Vikings did not have horns on their helmets, meaning the '''Stone Viking''' was a false depiction of them.
*Despite the fact that the '''Stone Viking''' had a sword, it did not attack towers with it, making it purely comestic.
*The '''Stone Viking's''' helmet is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|121925071|8-Bit Viking}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
